review_text: The fuel valve sticks open after I turn the knob off. Gas keeps hissing out; I stopped using it.
Comfortable straps and enough room for lunch and a rain layer. No complaints after six walks.
The left sole started peeling after two dry walks. I expected these to last longer.
Keeps light rain out, but feels stuffy on an uphill walk. Fine for standing around.
The battery compartment got so hot that the plastic melted and burned my finger.
Warm without bunching inside my boots. Washed them twice and they still fit.
One zipper jams at the corner. The fabric and poles seem fine.
The shoulder buckle snapped under load on a steep trail and the pack fell onto my foot.
No leaks and easy to clean. I wish the lid were easier to open with gloves.
They are poles. They arrived. Not sure what else to say until I use them.
Stayed cozy on a cool campsite night. The storage sack is roomy enough.
Boils a small pot quickly. The folding legs are handy on a flat picnic table.
Five-star blister factory, truly impressive. My heels were rubbed raw on the first walk.
The waist fits but the legs are much longer than expected. No damage or leaks.
The locking section collapsed while supporting me downhill. I fell and scraped my knee.
Bright enough for a familiar path. The strap takes a moment to adjust.
A simple mug that keeps my drink warm. Exactly what I wanted.
Rain dripped through a seam during a mild shower. Everything inside got damp.
Still deciding. They feel different from my old pair, but I have no specific complaint.
The filter housing split during use. Dirty water bypassed the cartridge and I drank some before noticing.
Fits my weekend kit well. The outside pocket could be a little deeper.
Both socks developed holes at the toes after three wears.
Light, packs small, and kept me dry during a long rainy walk.
Comfortable on grass. A bit noisy when I turn over, but it stays inflated.
The charging port sparked and caught the nearby cloth on fire. I unplugged it immediately.
Looks all right. Have not taken it outdoors yet, so this is only a first impression.
The ignition button does nothing. It lights with a separate lighter, but that is frustrating.
Good grip on dry paths and comfortable out of the box.
The cap seal leaks when the bottle lies on its side in my bag.
The seat support broke while I was sitting down. A sharp metal edge cut my leg.
Easy for one person to pitch. Two wide sleeping mats are a snug fit.
It shuts off every few minutes with fresh batteries. This happened while testing it at home.
A little thicker than I prefer for summer. Otherwise they are fine.
The hip belt spreads the weight nicely. No sore shoulders on my weekend walk.
Flames shot out at the hose connection instead of the burner, even after checking the fitting.
The cuff stitching came loose before the first wash. The rest looks well made.
Packs neatly and feels soft. The zipper pull is small with cold fingers.
Easy to adjust and the handles feel comfortable over a full day.
It holds tea. That is the whole review. Nothing broken.
Love the surprise of a pocket zipper falling off on day two. Very convenient, obviously.
Easy to squeeze and the directions were clear. Flow is a little slow but acceptable.
Something feels off around the arch. I cannot tell whether I need a different size.
Kept my legs dry and fit over my hiking trousers without a struggle.
Slow air leak overnight on the living room floor. I cannot find the hole.
Soft light for reading in the tent. Would like a lower brightness option.
Supportive on uneven paths. Needed a few short walks to soften up.
The color looks darker than the photo. Size is right and all the fasteners work.
Weathered a breezy weekend well. Clear instructions and no missing parts.
Okay, I guess. Ask me again after another trip; no actual fault to report yet.
Ordered another pair because the first pair stayed comfortable all day.
